title: Pure Train
summary: Pure Train (Railway) EARTH Machine Rank 10 Xyz build featuring the 2026 support (Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker, Night Train Blue Traveler, Exceptional Schedule, Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher, and Gustav Rocket) with generic staples.

summary.title: Starters
points: Night Train Blue Traveler discards itself to search Revolving Switchyard, and once per Duel revives itself alongside another EARTH Machine from the GY.

Revolving Switchyard discards 1 card to search a Level 10 EARTH Machine (or triggers when a Level 10 EARTH Machine is Normal or Special Summoned to Special Summon a Level 4 EARTH Machine with 1800+ ATK from the Deck as a Level 10).

Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker and Night Express Knight can both be Normal Summoned without Tributing as Level 10 EARTH Machines, and Babeldecker immediately Special Summons another EARTH Machine from the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Night Train Blue Traveler (or Revolving Switchyard + Any Discard)
steps: Discard Night Train Blue Traveler to search and activate Revolving Switchyard, then discard a card (such as Ruffian Railcar) with Switchyard to search Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker or Heavy Freight Train Derricrane.

Normal Summon Babeldecker without Tributing (or Special Summon Derricrane when an EARTH Machine is summoned), triggering Revolving Switchyard to Special Summon Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede from the Deck as a Level 10.

Overlay two Level 10s into Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher (which searches Barrage Blast or an EARTH Machine and grants an extra Machine Normal Summon) or Number 81: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Super Dora.

summary.title: Level Modulation & Recursion
summary.text: Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede revives an EARTH Machine from the GY on summon and matches the Level of itself and another monster on your field for an instant Rank 10. Heavy Freight Train Derricrane Special Summons itself from the hand whenever an EARTH Machine is Normal or Special Summoned and destroys a card on the field whenever it is detached as Xyz Material. Super Express Bullet Train recycles a Machine from the GY in the End Phase after it is sent there, and Double Headed Anger Knuckle revives Level 10 Machines on either turn.

summary.title: Rank 10 Rail Cannon Bosses
points: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max detaches 1 material to burn the opponent for 2000 damage, then ranks up into Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket (which negates and destroys a monster and burns) or Rank 11 Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe (which reaches 6000 ATK and attacks monsters up to its number of materials + 1).

Number 81: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Super Dora detaches 1 material (popping a card if it detaches Derricrane) as a Quick Effect to make a face-up monster unaffected by other card effects for the turn.
Heavy Armored Train Ironwolf, Number 27: Dreadnought Dreadnoid, Infinitrack River Stormer, Qliphort Genius, and Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder round out the Extra Deck utility.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Exceptional Schedule searches Urgent Schedule or Special Schedule, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Level 10 Machine.

Urgent Schedule Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower and 1 Level 5 or higher EARTH Machine from the Deck when the opponent controls more monsters, and searches a Level 10 Machine if destroyed while Set.

Special Schedule revives a Machine with 3000+ ATK from the GY, while Barrage Blast detaches any number of materials from a Machine Xyz to destroy that many cards on the field and banishes itself with a Machine Xyz from the GY for burn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's multi-engine Earth Machine hybrids that mix full Infinitrack, Machina, Ancient Gear, Gadget, and K9 packages are omitted to keep this build focused on the pure Railway cards.
